description: This file contains the definition of the FillFormatRenderer class, responsible for rendering fill formats in PDF documents using MigraDoc and PdfSharp libraries.

classes.name: FillFormatRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering fill formats (such as colors and patterns) onto a graphics context for PDF rendering.

methods.name: FillFormatRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a FillFormat object and a graphics context.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Draws a filled rectangle at given coordinates with specified dimensions.

methods.name: IsVisible
methods.description: Determines if the fill format should be rendered based on its visibility properties.

methods.name: GetBrush
methods.description: Creates and returns an XBrush object based on the fill format's color and visibility.
